title: 加拿大贸易部长：对华合作持务实态度，欢迎外资
speaker: Maninder Sidhu

segments.en: Give us an understanding of how you're looking at Chinese investments in energy in Canada, in particular.
segments.zh: 请谈谈您如何看待中国在加拿大能源领域的**，特别是这一点。

segments.en: I mean, how far are you willing to go to allow Chinese investments in, you know, energy infrastructure in Canada?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你们愿意在多大程度上允许中国**加拿大的能源基础设施？

segments.en: So if you, I can give you one example. LNG, Canada, too.
segments.zh: 我可以给你一个例子。加拿大LNG项目也是。

segments.en: Petro, China has invested into that project as a minority shareholder.
segments.zh: 中国已作为少数股东**了那个项目。

segments.en: So they're limits. Of course, there are limits. There's parameters for everything we do in Canada.
segments.zh: 所以是有限制的。当然有限制。我们在加拿大做的每件事都有参数。

segments.en: And so we've been very clear about what those parameters are. We welcome investments in modern agriculture, in financial services, in energy.
segments.zh: 我们已经非常明确这些参数是什么。我们欢迎在现代农业、金融服务、能源领域的**。

segments.en: And so this is some of the areas that we are exploring more opportunities in China.
segments.zh: 这些是我们正在中国探索更多机会的一些领域。

segments.en: The wall has been consumed by the NVIDIA and Spirinage scandal.
segments.zh: 整个事件已被英伟达和斯皮里纳奇丑闻所占据。

segments.en: I'm just wondering if that is shaping Canada's perspective in its trade relationship with China.
segments.zh: 我想知道这是否影响了加拿大对华贸易关系的看法。

segments.en: I wouldn't say so. I mean, I won't speak to the personal actions of one person, but, you know, our region.
segments.zh: 我不会这么说。我的意思是，我不会谈论某个人的个人行为，但是，你知道，我们地区。

segments.en: China has often been seen as being involved in technological espionage.
segments.zh: 中国常被视为涉及技术间谍活动。

segments.en: I mean, Canada has been a victim of that. So does that change the way you look at China as a trading partner?
segments.zh: 我是说，加拿大曾是受害者。那么这是否改变了你对中国作为贸易伙伴的看法？

segments.en: Well, I would say our approach to China is very pragmatic. Eyes wide open.
segments.zh: 嗯，我想说我们对中国的态度非常务实。保持警惕。

segments.en: We have discussions on where we can collaborate on.
segments.zh: 我们讨论可以合作的领域。

segments.en: And so working on the areas of collaboration are important and putting aside the things where we don't see eye to eye is also very important.
segments.zh: 因此，在合作领域开展工作很重要，搁置分歧也很重要。

segments.en: And so, again, our approach to our trading relations partners all around the world is being constructive and being pragmatic about that.
segments.zh: 所以，再次强调，我们与全球贸易伙伴的关系态度是建设性和务实的。

segments.en: Because you cannot ignore the second largest market in the world.
segments.zh: 因为你不能忽视世界第二大市场。

segments.en: Our business and our consumers want to do more there. And so you do that in a way where you're opening up opportunities for not just the large-scale businesses, but for the small SMEs is what's also on my mind.
segments.zh: 我们的企业和消费者希望在那里做更多。因此，你这样做的方式是为不仅大型企业，也为中小企业打开机会，这也是我所考虑的。
